observations: The production lookup_fault body rejects a child MM paired with the inherited parent MappingFile before invoking LOOKUP; its parent-MM control invokes LOOKUP and returns the fixture page.
The production Remote::worker body rejects a newly reserved child with prepare=None, without opening a mailbox worker or emitting a handle.
A successfully prepared control opens its worker, while pending or failed preparation does not.

finite_missing_apis.need: Add kernel-only fork reserve/commit/abort operations through the existing retained application connection. A reservation binds exact parent connection and retained delivery, child connection, referenced Linux child identity, validated range and physical root. No user-provided opaque worker/delivery token or unvalidated table is authority. Do not choose opcode values before independent contract review.
Route the added operations through application_invoke with exact buffer sizes and existing OS/module lease; unknown operations remain rejected.

Connect fork reservation to the exact runtime memory validator and application Remote. LOOKUP/TRANSFER must resolve an explicit adopted child image owner rather than parent Preparation or a fabricated PREPARE response.

Own the cross-entry fork reservation, all preallocated child state, commit/rollback, successful guest-link observation, cancellation and retirement under the existing slots lock. New child state must support independent workers/procfs/cleanup without emitting PREPARE or SCHEDULE for the existing guest child. Preserve all existing prepared-image paths.

Represent adopted image geometry/root/CPU and credentials explicitly. Preparation contains a real pending exchange and cannot safely be synthesized as success. Separate adopted ownership from PREPARE buffers, thread target and schedule authorization.

Inspect and exclusively reserve the exact retained Delivered nr56 request, matching args1=start,args2=len,args3=root, worker ownership and parent token. Retain the response claim through reservation and ordinary RET publication; reject simultaneous/replayed adoption. Reconcile the second nr56 linkage handshake and cancellation with worker/process close.

two_handshake_invariants.first: kernel/syscall.c::do_fork delegates nr56 with clone host flags, child range and newly cloned page-table root BEFORE assigning newproc->pid from the host result. Reserve only the exact Delivered request; descriptor values alone confer no authority.
two_handshake_invariants.second: After chain_thread and chain_process, the guest delegates another nr56 with args0=1,args1=child_tid BEFORE runq_add_thread. Correlate it to the first retained parent transaction and actual committed child PID. This is the existing success-side proof that guest PID linkage occurred.
two_handshake_invariants.before_second: An absent guest PID hash is not a retirement proof: the first host return may not yet have installed that PID. Child worker readiness and child scheduled/retired flags must not fabricate that proof.
two_handshake_invariants.independent_lifetimes: After successful linkage, parent and child own different registration, mirror/MM identity, backend image root, worker tokens, procfs owner and cleanup/retirement exchange. Release the temporary parent fork reservation only at the proven transition; the child must not retain the parent's active cleanup lifetime.

guest_boundary_decision_required.reason: Paths after the first successful host return can go to release_ids/destroy_thread before the second linkage handshake. There is no fork-specific notification after release_thread in the inspected body. Current parent/child backend APIs cannot prove that this unpublished guest child has been destroyed merely from an absent PID hash.
guest_boundary_decision_required.required_review_decision: For complete pre-link failure retirement, extend the native guest path with an exact parent-transaction/root-bound post-release acknowledgement unless independent review identifies an existing ordered event that already proves that release. A reserve/abort host opcode alone is insufficient. Preserve the legacy path and original request fields. Any uncertain postpublication failure must retain/quarantine the transaction rather than report complete rollback.
guest_boundary_decision_required.not_yet_authorized: No guest or additional host production file was changed. The dispatcher must receive independent boundary review before extending this lane.
